Sarah K.: Heads up 1: vendor Quasar Dataworks submitted INV-2026-314 against PO-88421 but AP rejected it due to tax on top of a PO line and the PO was reclassified last week. Can we get routing/approval?
Mike C.: AP error shows 'PO mismatch / tax allocation not allowed'. We need PO updated to include tax or a procurement memo for one-off approval.
Raj P.: Confirming PO-88421 was moved to COST-ENG-3; approver routing changed to Julia W. AP likely can't match approver due to the cost center change.
Sarah K.: AP Bot: 'Invoice missing matching PO line for tax amount'. Procurement, can you add a tax allowance or confirm approval?
Julia W.: I can approve now if Raj posts a confirmation note for audit. Reopening the PO is an option but takes ~2 business days.
Raj P.: Confirmed, Quasar work for Q1 latency testing billed to COST-ENG-3, tax valid. @Julia W. please approve.
AP Bot: 'Invoice INV-2026-314: held - awaiting approver confirmation or PO amendment. Attach supporting doc to release.'
procure-bot: 'PO-88421 status: closed -> reopen_requested by Julia W. ETA 2 business days.'
Mike C.: Sarah, please attach vendor statement and Raj's confirmation to FIN ticket so AP can clear without waiting for PO reopen. Also add tax guidance to PO template.
Sarah K.: Uploaded docs to FIN-3421 (link). @Julia W. please approve in AP UI when convenient.
Julia W.: Approved in AP; requested PO reopen. procure-bot acknowledged.
AP Bot: 'Invoice INV-2026-314: approval recorded by Julia W. - queued for payment. Expected run next Tue.'
Sarah K.: Thanks all. Closing FIN-3421 after payment posts. Action: procurement to add tax handling to PO checklist. :white_check_mark:
